summary: An MCP tool description is read by the model on every single call, and nobody scrolls past it. mcp-vet reads the source before you install: 31 rules covering tool poisoning, exfiltration paths, install hooks and registry provenance, every finding quoted with file:line. Never executes what it audits. Zero dependencies, 289 tests.
key_features: Reads an MCP server's source before you install it - 31 rules across tool poisoning, exfiltration paths, install hooks and registry provenance
Every finding is quoted with file:line, so a claim can be checked rather than believed
JSON output and a CI mode, plus a version diff between two releases of the same server

social.headline: An MCP tool description is read on every call. Nobody scrolls past it. mcp-vet does.

provenance.rule: mechanical fields read from the repository and the GitHub API; editorial fields hand-written and reviewed; no field is generated from a guess
